why: RJ-P51: opens logo.png (48 x 32, flat white, a navy disc of radius 10 at 24, 16 with a 4 x 4 supersampled anti-aliased edge), fills from (4, 4) at tolerance 32, contiguous, red, and exports a PNG. The trap: the fill bleeds into the anti-aliased edge or misses the corners. The assertion, against expected/logo-filled.png: every white pixel is red and the disc, its anti-aliased edge included, is byte-identical to the input: the bucket's soft edge stays inside the tolerance, so no edge pixel past it is tinted (#5093).
